mcqs.q: Which classical dance form of India originated and flourished in the royal courts (Darbar) of Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh?
mcqs.exp: Kathak derives from the Sanskrit word 'Katha' (storytelling) and was patronized by Nawab Wajid Ali Shah of Awadh.

mcqs.q: Where did Lord Buddha preach his very first sermon (Dhammacakkappavattana Sutta) after attaining enlightenment?
mcqs.exp: Lord Buddha delivered his first sermon at the Deer Park in Sarnath near Varanasi.

subtopics.name: Geography
subtopics.summary: Location, borders, physical terrain, and major river systems of Uttar Pradesh.

facts.title: Capital & Geographic Scope
facts.content: The capital is Lucknow. Uttar Pradesh covers a geographic area of 240,928 sq km across 75 administrative districts.

facts.title: Major Rivers & Drainage Systems
facts.content: Key river systems flowing through the region include: Ganga, Yamuna, Sarayu (Ayodhya), Gomti (Lucknow), Betwa, Ken, Hindon.

facts.title: Geographical Landscape & Highlights
facts.content: India's most populous state (over 24 crore citizens, sends 80 MPs to Lok Sabha). Cultural core of Indo-Aryan civilization: Varanasi (world's oldest living city), Ayodhya, Mathura, Prayagraj Kumbh Mela, and the Taj Mahal.

subtopics.name: History & Culture
subtopics.summary: Historical formation, classical/folk dances, and vibrant festivals of Uttar Pradesh.

facts.title: State Formation & Language
facts.content: Uttar Pradesh was formally instituted on 24 January 1950. Official language(s): Hindi, Urdu.

facts.title: Dance Forms & Traditional Arts
facts.content: Celebrated traditional and folk dance forms: Kathak (Classical Dance), Charkula, Raslila, Nautanki, Kajari.

facts.title: Major Festivals & Celebrations
facts.content: Prominent cultural festivals: Kumbh Mela (Prayagraj), Deepotsav (Ayodhya), Ganga Mahotsav, Lathmar Holi.

subtopics.name: Government & Polity
subtopics.summary: Constitutional leadership, administrative structure, and state symbols of Uttar Pradesh.

facts.title: Governor & Constitutional Head
facts.content: The current Governor is Anandiben Patel.

facts.title: Chief Minister & Administration
facts.content: The Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh is Yogi Adityanath.

facts.title: High Court Jurisdiction
facts.content: Judicial jurisdiction falls under Allahabad High Court (Prayagraj, Lucknow Bench).

facts.title: Official State Symbols
facts.content: State Animal: Barasingha | State Bird: Sarus crane | State Flower: Palash | State Tree: Ashoka.

subtopics.name: Economy & Agriculture
subtopics.summary: Natural resources, minerals, industrial clusters, and agriculture in Uttar Pradesh.

facts.title: Mineral Wealth & Natural Resources
facts.content: Principal minerals and resources: Limestone (Sonbhadra), Silica sand, Bauxite, Dolomite.

facts.title: Economic Profile & Industries
facts.content: Uttar Pradesh plays a vital role in India's economy through key agricultural production, manufacturing corridors, and services.

subtopics.name: Places, Monuments & Tourism
subtopics.summary: Heritage landmarks, national parks, and tourism attractions in Uttar Pradesh.

facts.title: Historic Monuments & Cultural Sites
facts.content: Prominent monuments and heritage landmarks: Taj Mahal (UNESCO), Agra Fort (UNESCO), Fatehpur Sikri (UNESCO), Kashi Vishwanath Corridor, Ram Mandir Ayodhya, Sarnath Dhamek Stupa.

facts.title: National Parks & Protected Areas
facts.content: Key protected conservation areas: Dudhwa National Park, Pilibhit Tiger Reserve, Ranipur Tiger Reserve.

subtopics.name: State Schemes & Awards
subtopics.summary: Prominent welfare schemes, civic initiatives, and state honors of Uttar Pradesh.

facts.title: Key State Welfare Schemes
facts.content: Notable welfare initiatives and government programs: One District One Product (ODOP), Mission Shakti, Kanya Sumangala Yojana.
